build.note: Source-provenance for the v0.2.1 contracts (F1 key-bound salt + native multi-signer recovery + OZ-hardened __check_auth + audit-hardening: soroban-sdk 27, mainnet TTL, credential-id cap, public_key in the deployed event, protected() removed). Reproduce: contracts/build.sh on the pinned toolchain (un-optimized, so cargo build reproduces the exact hash with no wasm-opt dependency). On-chain wasm hashes match per-network below.
build.status: BUILT + unit-tested + e2e-proven on testnet (see testnetV02) and DEPLOYED to mainnet (see mainnet block) with on-chain wasm hashes matching this reproducible build. Internal 3-lens review done (security/deploy/tests); NO external audit. Mainnet was deployed at the owner's explicit direction ahead of an external audit.

mainnet.note: v0.2.1 contracts deployed to Stellar mainnet (public). On-chain wasm hashes MATCH the local reproducible build (contracts/build.sh); the CLI-returned upload hashes equal build.wasm. NO external audit; deployed at the owner's explicit direction. The webauthn-account wasm CODE entry has its own TTL the account cannot self-extend, so extend it (and the factory instance) per contracts/MAINNET-RUNBOOK.md Step 3b.

webauthnAccount.note: Multi-signer secp256r1 account; __constructor(public_key), add_signer/remove_signer/is_signer/signer_count, OZ-hardened __check_auth. Deployed per passkey by the factory. Signature struct { authenticator_data, client_data_json, public_key, signature }.

transferProof.note: REAL passkey-signed 0.2 XLM PAYMENT on MAINNET via the native SAC: fresh passkey -> factory deploy -> fund 0.3 XLM -> passkey authorizes a 0.2 XLM transfer. Correct key SUCCESS (Horizon successful=true, ledger 64092090). A wrong key is REJECTED on-chain by __check_auth (transferFailTx, Horizon successful=false). Reproduce: packages/core/scripts/transfer-e2e-mainnet.ts (payment) and scripts/wrongkey-reject-mainnet.ts (rejection).

ttlExtend.note: Both wasm CODE entries and the factory instance extended to ~180 days (network max_entry_ttl is 3110400 ledgers; target 3110000, just under the boundary the extend op rejects). A contract cannot self-extend the shared CODE entry, so re-run contracts/extend-ttl.sh before the TTL drops under ~90 days (rent ~27 XLM to re-max).

factoryDeployProof.note: Test invocation proving the factory deploys + emits the indexer event.

transferProof.note: REAL passkey-authorized XLM transfer (25 XLM) from a factory-deployed smart account to a fresh account, via the native SAC. Correct key SUCCESS, wrong key FAILED. Reproduce: scripts/transfer-e2e.ts

smartWalletV1.note: passkey-kit v1 (v0.13.0, Protocol 27) canonical testnet smart-wallet wasm. NOT audited: kalepail/passkey-kit's own README states it is demo material, not audited, and must not be used to hold or secure value. Used ONLY for testnet compatibility proofs of the Signatures(Map<SignerKey, Signature>) ABI via signTransaction({ target: 'smart-wallet' }); shape confirmed by kalepail in issue #32. Not a mainnet substrate; the v0.2 webauthn-account provides native multi-device recovery for mainnet.

addSignerProof.note: Multi-device recovery (Tranche 2 D1): deploy a passkey-kit v1 smart-wallet with passkey A, then enroll a SECOND passkey via @soropass/core addSigner (authorized by A), PERSISTED on testnet (txSuccess, invokeHostFunctionSuccess). Reproduce: pnpm --filter @soropass/core exec tsx scripts/add-signer-e2e.ts

demoRunProof.note: Full Tranche 2 D3 demo run on a passkey-kit v1 smart-wallet, all persisted: deploy -> fund -> passkey-signed payment (10 XLM via native SAC, sendSmartWalletTx) -> wrong-key payment REJECTED on-chain -> add second device (addSigner). Everything after deploy driven by @soropass/core. Reproduce: pnpm --filter @soropass/core exec tsx scripts/demo-run-e2e.ts

removeSignerProof.note: remove_signer proven against passkey-kit v1 on testnet: deploy wallet with A, add B, then remove B (all authorized by A, all persisted). Reproduce: pnpm --filter @soropass/core exec tsx scripts/remove-signer-e2e.ts

v1LifecycleProof.note: Full v1 account-lifecycle via SDK adapters (smartWalletV1Deployer + smartWalletV1Indexer): deterministic deploy -> deriveSmartWalletAddress (offline) === deployed address -> resolveByCredential(founding) -> wallet -> add second device -> resolveByCredential(second) -> SAME wallet. This makes connect/recover/getAddress v1-native. Re-verifies the paginated indexer (collectEventsToTip) that resolves recent wallets across the RPC event window. v0.13.0 event schema captured empirically (topic[0]=Symbol('signer_added'), topic[1]=SignerKey::Secp256r1(rawCredId), wallet=emitting contract) via scripts/v1-events-probe.ts. Reproduce: pnpm --filter @soropass/core exec tsx scripts/v1-lifecycle-e2e.ts
